title: Mechanistic role of RND3-regulated IL33/ST2 signaling on cardiomyocyte senescence.
authors: Wu, Linxu; Zhu, Xinglin; Luo, Cai; Zhao, Yangyang; Pan, Shanshan; Shi, Kaijia; Chen, Yan; Qiu, Jianmin; Shen, Zhihua; Guo, Junli; Jie, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RND3调控IL33/ST2信号通路对心肌细胞衰老的作用，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞衰老与炎症信号，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hyperinflammatory responses are pivotal in the cardiomyocyte senescence pathophysiology, with IL33 serving as a crucial pro-inflammatory mediator. Our previous findings highlighted RND3's suppressive effect on IL33 expression. This study aims to explore the role of RND3 in IL33/ST2 signaling activation and in cardiomyocyte senescence. Intramyocardial injection of exogenous IL33 reduces the ejection fraction and fractional shortening of rats, inducing the appearance of senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) in myocardial tissues. Recombinant IL33 treatment of AC16 cardiomyocytes significantly upregulated expression of SASP factors like IL1alpha, IL6, and MCP1, and increased the p-p65/p65 ratio and proportions of SA-beta-gal and gammaH2AX-positive cells. NF-kappaB inhibitor pyrrolidinedithiocarbamate ammonium (PDTC) and ST2 antibody astegolimab treatments mitigated above effects. RND3 gene knockout H9C2 cardiomyocytes using CRISPR/Cas9 technology upregulated IL33, ST2L, IL1alpha, IL6, and MCP1 levels, decreased sST2 levels, and increased SA-beta-gal and gammaH2AX-positive cells. A highly possibility of binding between RND3 and IL33 proteins was showed by molecular docking and co-immunoprecipitation, and loss of RND3 attenuated ubiquitination mediated degradation of IL33; what's more, a panel of ubiquitination regulatory genes closely related to RND3 were screened using qPCR array. In contrast, RND3 overexpression in rats by injection of AAV9-CMV-RND3 particles inhibited IL33, ST2L, IL1alpha, IL6, and MCP1 expression in cardiac tissues, decreased serum IL33 levels, and increased sST2 levels. These results suggest that RND3 expression in cardiomyocytes modulates cell senescence by inhibiting the IL33/ST2/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, underscoring its potential as a therapeutic target in cardiovascular senescence.
abstract_zh: 高炎症反应在心肌细胞衰老病理生理中起关键作用，其中IL33作为重要的促炎介质。我们先前的研究强调了RND3对IL33表达的抑制作用。本研究旨在探讨RND3在IL33/ST2信号激活及心肌细胞衰老中的作用。心肌内注射外源性IL33可降低大鼠的射血分数和缩短分数，并诱导心肌组织出现衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）。重组IL33处理AC16心肌细胞显著上调了IL1alpha、IL6和MCP1等SASP因子的表达，并增加了p-p65/p65比值以及SA-beta-gal和gammaH2AX阳性细胞的比例。NF-kappaB抑制剂吡咯烷二硫代氨基甲酸铵（PDTC）和ST2抗体astegolimab处理可缓解上述效应。使用CRISPR/Cas9技术敲除RND3基因的H9C2心肌细胞上调了IL33、ST2L、IL1alpha、IL6和MCP1水平，降低了sST2水平，并增加了SA-beta-gal和gammaH2AX阳性细胞。分子对接和免疫共沉淀显示RND3与IL33蛋白之间存在高度可能的结合，且RND3缺失减弱了IL33的泛素化介导降解；此外，通过qPCR阵列筛选出一组与RND3密切相关的泛素化调控基因。相反，通过注射AAV9-CMV-RND3颗粒在大鼠中过表达RND3抑制了心脏组织中IL33、ST2L、IL1alpha、IL6和MCP1的表达，降低了血清IL33水平，并增加了sST2水平。这些结果表明，心肌细胞中RND3的表达通过抑制IL33/ST2/NF-kappaB信号通路调节细胞衰老，凸显其作为心血管衰老治疗靶点的潜力。
